vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: shrimp-wechat-mp-reader
Version: 0.1.0

The skill is a legitimate tool designed to scrape and extract text from WeChat Official Account articles using Playwright. The code in `scripts/extract.js` and the orchestration in `run.sh` align perfectly with the stated purpose in `SKILL.md`. While the scripts perform automated browser installation and dependency management (`npm install`), these are standard requirements for Playwright-based automation and show no signs of intentional malice, data exfiltration, or unauthorized access.

llm.summary: The skill's files, instructions, and required actions are consistent with its claimed purpose (using Playwright to render a WeChat article and extract title/body); it installs Playwright via npm and runs a local browser, and it does not request unrelated credentials or hidden endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the code and SKILL.md: the scripts launch Playwright, navigate to the provided mp.weixin.qq.com URL, and extract title and body text. The declared dependencies (playwright in package.json/lock) are appropriate for the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md gives concrete runtime steps and file paths and asks the agent to run the included setup and run scripts. The instructions reference an absolute example path (/home/baiwan/...), which is environment-specific and may not apply to other hosts; otherwise the runtime steps are limited to installing dependencies and invoking the extractor on a provided URL (no extra data collection or hidden steps).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No remote arbitrary download URLs are used; installation uses npm and npx playwright install chromium (Playwright and browser binaries from the official npm registry / Playwright provider). This is expected for Playwright-based tools but will download large browser binaries during setup.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, no credentials, and does not read other config paths. Its use of PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH to cache browser binaries under the user's HOME is reasonable and proportionate.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated or persistent platform privileges. It does write Playwright browser files to the user's cache directory (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH) when installing, which is expected.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it runs npm install and uses Playwright to open the provided WeChat article URL and print a JSON with title and body text. Before installing, note: (1) npm install and 'npx playwright install chromium' will download packages and large browser binaries from the public registries — run in an environment where that network activity and disk usage are acceptable; (2) the SKILL.md contains an absolute example path (/home/baiwan/...), so adapt commands to your environment; (3) the extractor launches a real browser (headless:false), which may open a GUI or require a display/X server on headless machines; (4) the tool navigates to arbitrary URLs you supply — only provide URLs you trust, and consider running in an isolated container if you worry about exposing your environment to remote page behavior. No credentials or hidden remote endpoints were found in the provided files.
